definitions.explanation: Describing something emotionally or physically difficult to endure. Expresses suffering or hardship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{辛|つら}い⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.notes: Expressing that work is difficult to endure

examples.japanese: ⟦{別|わか}れる→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{辛|つら}かった。
{辛|つら}いこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あったら→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If something difficult happens, please talk to me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{辛|つら}い⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}えないで→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。⟦{誰|だれ}か→誰か：02912_dareka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Please don't keep your painful feelings to yourself. It's important to talk to someone.

notes:
{辛|つら}い describes something emotionally or physically painful and hard to endure — hardship, suffering, or distress. It is broader than ⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧ (physical pain) and more personal than ⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧ (tough/difficult).

FORMS:
- Negative: {辛|つら}くない
- Te-form: {辛|つら}くて
- Past: {辛|つら}かった
- Adverb: {辛|つら}く

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {辛|つら}い⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: a painful experience
- {辛|つら}い⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go through a difficult time
- {辛|つら}い⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: a hard period

KANJI NOTE:
The kanji {辛|つら} has two readings with very different meanings:
- {辛|つら}い (つらい): painful, hard to bear
- ⟦{辛|から}い→辛い：00638_karai⟧ (からい): spicy, hot
Context usually makes the meaning clear.
